first_write_rule: A game prediction may be created once before kickoff. Existing bytes must validate against this exact candidate/artifact identity and may never be overwritten or regenerated.
schedule_rule: Exact nflverse games.csv bytes are SHA256 archived. Only game_type, season, week, gameday, gametime, game_id, home_team, and away_team may determine the captured game identity/time inputs. Sportsbook price fields are forbidden model inputs.
temporal_rule: captured_at_utc must be strictly after V2G preregistration and strictly before kickoff_utc.
capture_code_change_rule: Any change to the frozen capture module, runner, or workflow Git blob requires a new append-only capture freeze before that changed code or workflow may create prospective prediction bytes.
